answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Lorry tachograph record with fleet operator attestation. It requires each record is months of driving hours logged by a fleet operator, so a farm must run a hundred real lorries, so the ember of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the beacon first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The dune is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
